scene: chana masala - chickpeas in a thick tomato curry - served against basmati rice in one bowl, with a herbed paratha on a plate alongside
notes: Solids in liquid where the solids are countable and sauce-covered: the chickpeas are individually visible but sit in enough curry to be read as one undifferentiated mass. The legume is the recall target and the sauce is a separate item, not a property of the chickpeas. Rice and paratha are both refined grain and merge to one serving. The paratha is laminated with fat that is not visible — noted, not scored, since the recipe is not known.
